settings.description: Expo demo app showing the @waynesutton/agent-ready React Native widget backed by Convex HTTP routes.

pages.title: Expo overview
pages.description: Mobile demo for the Agent Ready Expo widget.
pages.fullContent: The Expo demo shows how a React Native app can link to agent-readable Convex routes. The mobile widget opens llms.txt, agents.md, llms-full.txt, status, and the markdown site.

pages.title: Markdown viewer
pages.description: Markdown site viewer designed for humans and agents.
pages.fullContent: The MARKDOWN tab reads /llms-markdown-index from the Convex site URL and opens /markdown pages. Humans get HTML. Agents can send Accept: text/markdown to get raw markdown.
